positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (SDE-3)
positions.description:
I work on MicroBus team.  MicroBus is fault tolerant, high performance, durable, log publishing service. It is a foundational and tier-0 service in AWS. It is used internally as a WAL.A bunch of public AWS services like S3, SQS, EC2, Kinesis, etc. are built on top of MicroBus.

My day-to-day technical work largely revolves around fault tolerance and performance of the replication algorithm and the underlying consensus algorithm (Paxos implementation).

positions.title: SDE 2
positions.description:
AlfBus/MicroBus team

I switched to AlfBus team in April 2022. At the time, we were building MicroBus, a new version of AlfBus service.  I was involved in building few performance critical aspects of MicroBus and leading through the operational readiness review, before the launch of the service. 
Have been deeply involved in helping customers (our customers are the public AWS services) in migrating from older version of AlfBus(built 12+ years ago)  to newer, performant verions.

positions.title: SDE 2
positions.description:
AWS IoT FleetWise

Early engineer on AWS IoT FleetWise. Joined the team when the product idea was just a document. Designed and built the tier-0 component of the product. Involved in doing everything that was needed to launch the product(in preview) at re:invent. 

https://aws.amazon.com/iot-fleetwise/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Part of the app live team where I worked on interesting challenges around service discovery. 
- Was part of the live team and worked on build process of chrome devtools and setting up the build process to make it version agnostic.
- Worked on issues around WebRTC.
- Worked on analytics platform that performed ETL jobs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Part of the team responsible for porting the codebase to Laravel framework and optimizing the code.
		 	 	
- Developed the shipping feature of the product. Integrated with shipping partners API such as FedEX, Aramex, Delhivery etc.
	 	 	
- Responsible for speed optimizations of the product and laying the base for future development of the product.
	 	 	
- Gained strong experience in integrating with third-party API.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed 	the database architecture for the first prototype of the product.

- Being the first engineer in the company at that time, wrote the entire initial business logic of the product.

- Used ElasticSearch for better optimizations of searches ,which increased the speed of search and gave relevant search results.

- Worked on HTML5,CSS,Javascript and AJAX for the integration of front-end with the back-end

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Worked in the Content development team of the company. Gained experience of working in a start-up environment.

projects.title: Wireless Security Using SSH Tunneling
projects.description: Developed an application that aims to provide additional security to wireless networks from security threats and attacks such as packet sniffing and session hijacking using SSH Tunneling. Using port forwarding and an SSH-like protocol, an SSH tunnel was created and all the traffic was passed through that tunnel. This provided encryption to all the packets passing through that tunnel. Application development was done using Java.

publications.title: Wireless Network Security by SSH Tunneling
publications.publisher: International Journal of Scientific and Research Publications · Apr 6, 2014
